info.title: LegalEase REST API
info.description: Backend REST API for LegalEase Contract Analysis Platform

post.description: Accepts a PDF or image file, uploads it to S3-compatible storage, creates a database record, and queues analysis.

example.message: Invalid file type. Only PDF and images (PNG, JPEG) are allowed.

get.description: Returns the analysis status and metadata of a single document by UUID.

get.description: Generates and downloads a complete PDF report of the contract analysis (including metadata, overall risk score, classified clauses, missing clauses, and chat history summary) using Puppeteer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the document to retrieve report for

200.description: PDF file retrieved successfully. Returns binary PDF.

post.summary: Generate signed expiring link for public sharing
post.description: Generates a JWT share token valid for 24 hours that allows read-only public access to the document's analysis.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the document to generate share link for

post.description: Creates a session for conversing with the RAG assistant about a specific document.

documentId.description: Unique identifier of the analyzed document

get.summary: Retrieve history of messages in a session
get.description: Returns a sorted list of all user and AI messages in a chat session.

content.example: What is the limitation of liability?

404.description: Chat session not found or access denied

post.summary: Send a user message to a chat session
post.description: Saves a user message in the database for the given session.

404.description: Chat session not found or access denied

get.summary: Get AI response token-by-token stream (Server-Sent Events)
get.description: Streams the AI RAG model response for the chat session. This returns a text/event-stream containing SSE data packets, not a JSON response.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Optional new message content from the user (if provided, saves the user message to DB before streaming)

200.description: Connection established successfully. Streams SSE event chunks.

schema.description:
Server-Sent Event packets formatted as:
`data: {"token": "next_word"}\n\n`

Stream termination packet formatted as:
`data: [DONE]\n\n`
